screens.name: projects/3486587707575590516/screens/c3708cd105824ce2aa2daacd55fa505b
screens.title: Linux MCP · Files Administration (834px Tablet)
screens.prompt: Design a TABLET 834px responsive Linux MCP 'Files' administration page using Slate Console theme. Collapsible compact navigation, separate operator alex@example.test / Demo self-hosted install, sticky remote target prod-web-01 app@192.0.2.10 revision7 independently verified. Heading 'Files' with allowed-root /etc/nginx only. Breadcrumb, bounded listing table path/type/owner/mode/revision, selected demo.conf revision12. Plain text editor preview and two-column or vertically stacked before/after diff with monospace line numbers: change worker_connections 1024 to 2048. Exact write intent shows canonical path, expected content revision12, 8KiB limit, backup only if supported, write permission requires policy/capability and approval. Show amber stale content / revision conflict warning 'Reload and compare; do not overwrite', unknown-after-submit notice 'Inspect current file before retry', action Review exact change rather than raw shell. Secondary capability summary for administration modules: Processes (PID+start identity), Packages (partial outcome), Storage READ-ONLY, Network (connectivity risk / unavailable changes), Scheduled Jobs (UTC + execution user), Access (privilege impact). Don't add unsupported actions. 44px controls, clear text statuses, internal table/code scrolling, no gradients. Synthetic prototype no live files.

screens.name: projects/3486587707575590516/screens/0302efbe19014813a95a65acb1e70a60
screens.title: Linux MCP · Mobile Monitoring & Workflow Progress (390px)
screens.prompt: Design MOBILE 390px Linux MCP Monitoring and workflow progress page using Slate Console. One vertical responsive page. Menu button instead of rail, operator alex@example.test / Demo self-hosted install separately from sticky target prod-web-01 app@192.0.2.10 r7 verified key. Heading 'Monitoring'. CPU24%, memory3.2/8GiB, disk28/80GiB, timestamps UTC and units. CPU history chart 08:00–08:30 with explicit visible sample gap 08:12–08:18 labeled 'No samples', never zero; small accessible data values. Read-only collection schedule every60s via explicitly delegated grant, expires tomorrow; revoked state stops collection. Alert inbox card sustained CPU >80% for5m, and unavailable-data state distinct. Workflow progress section 'Investigate nginx': collect evidence complete, restart nginx.service step2 waiting for exact human approval, verify pending. Resolved step preview binds target/r7/action/args/expiry; workflow name is not approval. Fleet comparison 2 of3 owned targets returned, staging unavailable, no fabricated full result. Amber unknown-after-submit/restart notice 'Inspect before resuming; never replay submitted changes'. No embedded AI required, no external notification provider, no fake live backend. 44px controls, all statuses with text/icon, internally bounded content, synthetic prototype. Prioritize calm hierarchy and readable mobile spacing.
